passengers.name: Mack Nightstripe
passengers.personality: Reserved veteran racer who respects daring but hates needless contact
passengers.greeting: The road tells you when to push. Listen first.
passengers.arrival: Clean finish. That counts more than noise.

passengers.name: Tobin Dryrun
passengers.clothing: Pale blue work jacket and scuffed boots
passengers.personality: Dry short-track wit and unhurried confidence
passengers.greeting: I was told this was a taxi. Nobody mentioned acreage.
passengers.arrival: Well. We got here before the paperwork.

passengers.name: Jax Sparkplug
passengers.clothing: Red checkered vest over racing whites
passengers.personality: Loud hothead who celebrates every overtake
passengers.greeting: Let's make those tires remember us!
passengers.arrival: Now THAT was a finish!

passengers.name: Burl Turnwell
passengers.clothing: Teal broadcast blazer and bright tie
passengers.personality: Warm southern race commentator with endless metaphors
passengers.greeting: Folks, we have ourselves a mighty unusual starting grid.
passengers.arrival: And there goes the checkered flag on a fine trip.

passengers.name: Clyde Ridgeway
passengers.personality: Patient Tennessee veteran who prizes consistency
passengers.greeting: Keep it steady and the miles look after themselves.
passengers.arrival: That's a good run. No need to dress it up.

passengers.name: Mara Brightwire
passengers.clothing: Clothed coral reporter jacket and dark trousers
passengers.personality: Quick-witted street reporter who flirts with danger, not strangers
passengers.greeting: I hope you drive as well as you make an entrance.
passengers.arrival: That ride has a headline.

passengers.name: Vela Starlane
passengers.clothing: Clothed cyan spaceflight coat and boots
passengers.personality: Playful space traveler fascinated by road signs
passengers.greeting: Ground travel? How charmingly unpredictable.
passengers.arrival: An excellent orbit around town.

passengers.name: Elodie Circuit
passengers.personality: Brilliant heiress who critiques the truck's engineering
passengers.greeting: I can improve your suspension after this trip.
passengers.arrival: Imperfect machine. Delightful operator.

passengers.name: Roxy Vale
passengers.personality: Alternates between daring and meticulous moods
passengers.greeting: I say floor it. My sensible half says hello first.
passengers.arrival: Both of us enjoyed that. Mostly.

passengers.name: Sable Flint
passengers.clothing: Clothed violet duster and wide-brim hat
passengers.personality: Dry magical gunslinger with a soft spot for odd vehicles
passengers.greeting: This rig has a strange sort of magic.
passengers.arrival: Not bad for a machine without a broom.

passengers.name: Nina Cipher
passengers.personality: Cool spy who notices every shortcut
passengers.greeting: Let's keep this route between us.
passengers.arrival: No one saw us. Impressive in a truck this size.

passengers.name: Tessa Ember
passengers.clothing: Clothed olive utility jacket and cargo pants
passengers.personality: Resourceful survivor with practical humor
passengers.greeting: I brought supplies. Did you bring brakes?
passengers.arrival: We made it, and I still have all my gear.

passengers.name: Juno Vector
passengers.personality: Disciplined agent who measures every turn
passengers.greeting: Objective: arrive with the mirrors attached.
passengers.arrival: Mission accomplished. Mirrors too.

passengers.name: Calla Stone
passengers.clothing: Clothed expedition shirt and field trousers
passengers.personality: Adventurous explorer who treats detours as discoveries
passengers.greeting: A new route? That sounds like an invitation.
passengers.arrival: The city has more secrets than the map admits.

passengers.name: Rowan Sol
passengers.personality: Confident sorceress whose magic dislikes potholes
passengers.greeting: I could teleport, but this looks more fun.
passengers.arrival: Your driving nearly outshone my spellwork.

passengers.name: Nyx Meridian
passengers.personality: Dramatic sorceress who loves a grand arrival
passengers.greeting: Let the streets witness our entrance.
passengers.arrival: A suitably theatrical finale.

passengers.name: Fern Hexley
passengers.clothing: Clothed moss cloak and patched trousers
passengers.personality: Whimsical witch who chats with roadside plants
passengers.greeting: The ivy says your truck is friendly.
passengers.arrival: The trees approve. That's rare.

passengers.name: Ada Exact
passengers.clothing: Clothed white and graphite field uniform
passengers.personality: Precise operative who values smooth execution
passengers.greeting: I appreciate punctuality and clean lines.
passengers.arrival: An efficient result. I noticed the flourish.

passengers.name: Lyra Pulse
passengers.personality: Rebellious biotic who loves controlled chaos
passengers.greeting: Hope this thing can handle a little momentum.
passengers.arrival: That was almost as lively as zero gravity.

passengers.name: Bea Ironcup
passengers.personality: Tough bartender with generous humor
passengers.greeting: Long shift. Give me the scenic route.
passengers.arrival: Good ride. First drink's on the house.

passengers.name: Iris Bloomward
passengers.personality: Gentle mystic who reads omens in traffic lights
passengers.greeting: The blossoms say this trip will surprise us.
passengers.arrival: A lovely journey, despite that one ominous cone.

passengers.name: Rhea North
passengers.clothing: Clothed light armor over travel leathers
passengers.personality: Steady huntress with keen roadside awareness
passengers.greeting: I prefer a driver who sees the whole road.
passengers.arrival: You kept your eyes where they mattered.

passengers.name: Mika Trail
passengers.personality: Calm veteran who prizes teamwork
passengers.greeting: I'll watch the right. You watch the lane.
passengers.arrival: Solid team effort.

passengers.name: Piper Ash
passengers.personality: Upbeat firefighter who keeps emergencies in perspective
passengers.greeting: No siren today, please. I'm off duty.
passengers.arrival: All clear. Nice work.

passengers.name: Lady Cora Vale
passengers.personality: Courteous warrior with exacting standards
passengers.greeting: A formidable carriage. Shall we?
passengers.arrival: You have earned my regard.

passengers.name: Solene Ward
passengers.personality: Observant officer with a gentle supernatural streak
passengers.greeting: I can sense a story in this machine.
passengers.arrival: A peaceful ending. I treasure those.

passengers.name: Kira Noct
passengers.personality: Quiet agent with sly one-liners
passengers.greeting: Subtle isn't really this truck's talent.
passengers.arrival: Still, somehow, we slipped through.

passengers.name: Dr. Mira Hale
passengers.clothing: Clothed white medic coat and field pants
passengers.personality: Compassionate medic who remains unruffled
passengers.greeting: Let's keep my medical bag closed.
passengers.arrival: Exactly the kind of uneventful journey I like.

passengers.name: Nora Redleaf
passengers.personality: Playful adult student with quick jokes
passengers.greeting: Late lecture, unusual taxi. This day has range.
passengers.arrival: I made it before the quiz. You're a legend.
